_readme: Copy this to profile.json and fill it in. Nothing here is uploaded anywhere - it stays on this machine and is only typed into forms you open yourself.

files._resume_by_keyword: Optional. Different resume depending on what the job is. 'match' is a regex tested against '<job title> <company>'; first match wins, and if its file is missing you get told rather than silently sent the default. Delete this list to always use files.resume.

_search: Defaults for collect_indeed.py, so the common case is just `python collect_indeed.py --resolve`. Overridden by --what / --where / --days.

answers._comment: Checked BEFORE the built-in rules, top to bottom. 'match' is a regex tested against the field's label text (case-insensitive).
